title: Why the Paycheck Did Not Land
the_thought: The big paycheck is a lock, not a deposit.
hook: Tesla printed about 158 billion dollars on Elon Musk's 2025 pay table.

levels.name: The Short
beats: Then a second line appeared for the same year. Realized pay sat at zero. The big paycheck is a lock, not a deposit. That huge number is a picture of new prizes, not cash that landed. Tesla's own realized table stayed empty. The older paper can still open: about 304 million options at about 23 dollars, wrapped in a job latch through January 2028 and a five-year hold. A second public ticker holds a 48.4 percent SpaceX claim, including locked shares that still have gates.
